notes.title: The VHS Update
notes.notes:
We wanted to express our gratitude to each and every one of you for your support and enjoyment of our game. We have poured our heart and soul into this game and we are thrilled that you are embracing it. Your kind words mean the world to us and motivate us to continue doing what we love, making game for you. 

We have heard your feedback and we are delighted to announce a major update which is now available, featuring hot fixes and new content that will transform the way you experience the game! [b]Please Enjoy![/b]

[b]Note:[/b] 📢 indicates changes inspired by community feedback!

[h1]Improvements/Bug Fixes/Changes[/h1]
📢Increased Brightness Limitation
📢Improved Box Locker so the selected number is more visible
📢Adjusted walking speed
📢Improved visibility of [spoiler]basement symbols pipe[/spoiler] puzzle
· Fix a bug where some sounds can be heard even if the audio is muted.

[h1]New Style[/h1]
We are excited to introduce a new gameplay style that will transform your gameplay experience completely! Initially, we envisioned a found footage VHS style for. However, we have decided to pursue a unique environment and style, which became the default.

As huge fans of the found footage horror genre, we believe many of you are too. While we are very pleased with the game's final style and it is our preferable style to play the game, we wanted to give players the option to choose their preferred style. This will also allow those who wish to re-experience the game in a fresh way to feel like they are playing it for the first time again.

Therefore [u][b]we are thrilled to bring the found footage VHS style to our game![/b][/u] This new style will create a realistic, different and very scary atmosphere. You can select your desired style only when you start a new game. We hope you enjoy this addition and that it satisfies our found footage horror fans.
